## Kind of change
- [ ] A post (`_posts/`)
- [ ] Layout, styles or scripts (`_layouts/`, `_includes/`, `assets/`)
- [ ] Site configuration or plugins (`_config.yml`, `_plugins/`)
- [ ] CI, build or tooling
- [ ] Dependencies

## How to test
- [ ] `bundle exec jekyll build` passes
- [ ] Checked locally with `bundle exec jekyll serve`
- [ ] A post: the front matter is complete (`layout`, `title`, `date`, `tags`, `author`, `description`) and every link opens
- [ ] A layout change: the home page, a post, a tag page and the feed still render, in both themes
